Single Terroir Release

Mullineux Single Terroir wines consistently earn exceptional top-tier ratings from local and international critics. The wines highlight how different Swartland soils — Granite, Iron and Schist — shape distinct expressions of Chenin Blanc and Syrah, from the estate named Platter's South African Winery of the Year an unprecedented five times (2014, 2016, 2019, 2020 and 2023).
